name: Virat Kohli Confused Gesturing
visual_description: Four-panel image of Indian cricketer Virat Kohli on the field in a blue jersey, gesturing with his hands out in confusion and disbelief.
usage_context: Used to express utter confusion, asking 'What did I do?', or questioning someone's bizarre reasoning or unfair decision.

example.top_text: Me explaining to my mom that the milk spilled on its own
